title: script_set MCP tool stores invalid AS2 scripts silently (ok:true even on compile error)
description: The script_set tool in packages/authoring-ui/src/agent/registry.ts always stores the script and always returns ok:true, even when compileCheckScript() returns diagnostics with severity:error. The compile check is explicitly marked non-blocking (line 1582). An agent that checks only the ok field will silently store a broken script that will fail at publish time. Fix: either (a) make ok:false when diagnostics contain errors and skip the pushDoc, or (b) at minimum document that agents MUST inspect diagnostics even when ok:true. The safer fix is (a) — match the user mental model that script_set succeeds only when the script is valid.
